Players Committee card image of [[Despair (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Opponent's characters deploy +1 to same site as Jabba's Prize. When you capture a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Your Force drains at same battleground site as Jabba's Prize are +1. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
